title: Liveness before the time bound
statement: Let $P$ and $Q$ be deterministic machines with $k$ Boolean work tapes, let $j$ be a work tape index, and choose states $p_{\mathrm{exit}}$ of $P$ and $q_{\mathrm{entry}},q_{\mathrm{acc}},q_{\mathrm{rej}}$ of $Q$. Suppose $P$ reaches configuration $c_P$ in state $p_{\mathrm{exit}}$ for the first time after $T_P$ steps on Boolean input $z$. Assume tape $j$ in $c_P$ has a block of $m$ nonblank cells starting at its head position, followed by a blank, and the cell immediately to the left of the head is blank. For every Boolean word $w$ of length strictly less than $T_P+2m+9$, the guess-and-run machine's configuration after processing $w$ from its initial configuration is not halted.
hypotheses_covered: $P,Q$ are deterministic machines with $k$ Boolean work tapes
$T_P$ is a natural number and $c_P$ is a configuration of $P$ on Boolean input $z$
$P$ run for $T_P$ steps from its initial configuration equals $c_P$
For a natural number $m$, tape $j$ has nonblank cells at offsets $p<m$ from its head
The cell at offset $m$ is blank
The cell one position left of the tape head is blank
$w$ is a Boolean word with length strictly less than $T_P+2m+9
